_howToEdit: All website text lives in this file. Change the words between the quotes, save, and refresh the page. The things you'll edit most (upcoming drives, past drives, gallery) are at the top. Wrap a word in *asterisks* inside a heading to make it orange and italic. Keep the commas and quotes exactly as they are. Dates are written YYYY-MM-DD. Keys starting with _ are notes and templates; the website ignores them.

hero.headline: No one should go to sleep *hungry.*
hero.intro: On Sunday mornings, our volunteers make sure food reaches people in need across Kolkata: planning each drive, arranging the food, getting it to the right streets and handing it out with care. When disaster strikes anywhere in Bengal, we take relief wherever it's needed most.
hero.imageAlt: The Hunger Warriors team in matching teal shirts, gathered together after a drive

about.heading: It began with *two friends on bikes.*
story: In 2021, as the COVID-19 lockdown emptied Kolkata's streets, our founders Mufaddal Bookwala and Hasnain Ukani saw what it meant for the people who had nowhere else to go. The homeless and the families living on the pavements had always lived on the edge. Now the shops were shut, the crowds had vanished, and no one was coming by with food.

They couldn't look away. So two friends got on their bikes and set out with whatever food they could arrange, for whoever needed it. For the first few months it was quiet and informal, through the lockdown and the hard months that followed.

Then people began asking how they could help. Two became five, five became seven, and seven became a family of more than 150 Hunger Warriors. Today we plan and run food drives across Kolkata, and whenever floods or cyclones hit Bengal, we load up and go.
about.mission: To reach the people our city overlooks, on the streets, outside hospitals and in Bengal's hardest-hit villages, with nourishing food and essentials, delivered with dignity, consistency and care.
about.vision: A Bengal where no one sleeps hungry, not a child, an elder or a family, and where feeding the person next to you is simply what neighbours do.

sections.title: Who we are
blocks: Hunger Warriors ("we", "us") is a volunteer-led initiative based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India, that organises food drives and disaster relief. These policies apply to this website, our WhatsApp and social media channels, donations, memberships and every drive we run.
Contact for anything on this page: foodforall@hungerwarriors.com · +91 9831108057 / +91 9831154686.

sections.title: Privacy Policy
blocks: We respect your privacy and handle personal data in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Information Technology Act, 2000.

list: This website has no accounts or sign-ups. The volunteer form does not send anything to us by itself; it opens WhatsApp with your message, and we only receive it if you press send.
When you message, call or email us: what you share, usually your name, phone number and message.

When you donate or become a member: the payment details your UPI app or bank shares with us (name, UPI ID or account name, amount, date and transaction reference). We never receive your UPI PIN, OTP, card or net-banking details.
At drives: photos and videos (see Photos, Videos & Media Consent).
To reply to you, organise drives and coordinate volunteers.
To send donation receipts, thank-you messages, drive updates and photos.
To manage memberships and keep accounting records.
To meet legal, tax and regulatory requirements, and to prevent fraud or misuse of our name.

blocks: We do not sell, rent or trade personal data. We share it only with payment providers and banks to process payments, with service providers who help us run our channels (such as WhatsApp), when the law requires it, or to protect the safety of people at our drives.

We take reasonable steps to keep your information safe, and limit access to the volunteers who need it. Donation records are kept for as long as accounting and tax laws require. Other contact details and messages are deleted when no longer needed, or sooner on request. If a data breach affects you, we will inform you and the authorities as the law requires.

You may ask to access, correct or delete your personal data, withdraw consent, or nominate someone to exercise these rights for you. Withdrawing consent doesn't affect anything we did before. Email us and we will acknowledge your request within 7 days and resolve it within 30 days.
If you contact us, donate or volunteer, we may message you on WhatsApp about drives and your donations. Reply STOP at any time and we'll stop.
We do not knowingly collect personal data from children through this website. Volunteers under 18 need the consent of a parent or guardian.
For privacy questions or complaints, contact our Grievance Officer at foodforall@hungerwarriors.com or +91 9831108057 / +91 9831154686.

list: We take photos and videos at drives so donors and the public can see where help goes.
By attending a drive, members and volunteers agree that photos and videos of them taken during the drive may be posted on our website and social media, and used in our updates, without payment.

If you would like a photo or video of you taken down, email us at foodforall@hungerwarriors.com. We will remove it from our website and our own social media pages promptly. We cannot control copies that others have already shared.

We photograph the people we serve with respect and dignity, ask permission wherever we can, and avoid sharing names or personal details. Anyone who appears in our photos can ask for them to be removed in the same way.
Volunteers taking photos at drives must follow the same standards and must not post images that could embarrass or harm the people we serve.
Donations are voluntary gifts. Nothing is provided in return, and a donation does not create any business relationship.
Donations are used for food, ration kits, relief supplies and the direct costs of running drives. We may direct funds to wherever the need is greatest at the time, including relief work.
Receipts are sent on WhatsApp. If you haven't received yours within 48 hours, send us your transaction reference.
Tax: unless your receipt clearly says otherwise, donations are not eligible for tax deduction (for example under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act, 1961).

Refunds are provided only for duplicate payments (the same amount paid more than once by mistake), and only after review by our team. To request one, email us within 30 days of the payment with both transaction references. Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method. No other refunds are made.

Monthly membership (₹500/month) runs through UPI AutoPay. You can pause or cancel anytime from your UPI app or by messaging us; this stops future payments. Payments already made are not refunded, except duplicates as above.
Donations in kind (food, clothes, supplies) are welcome. We may decline items that aren't safe or suitable, and we can't return items once they've been distributed.
We accept money only through the payment details on this website. We will never ask for your UPI PIN, OTP, card number or passwords.
Volunteering is unpaid and voluntary, and does not create employment or any other legal relationship.
Drive dates, times and locations can change or be cancelled at short notice because of weather, safety or need. Please confirm on WhatsApp before you set out.

You take part at your own risk. Follow the drive lead's instructions, look after your own health, belongings and transport, and stay safe on the road, especially on two-wheelers. Hunger Warriors is not liable for injury, illness, loss or damage during drives, except where the law does not allow this to be excluded.
Volunteers under 18 must have written or WhatsApp consent from a parent or guardian, and should attend with an adult.

Treat everyone with dignity. Harassment, discrimination, intoxication, collecting money from the people we serve, or promoting any political or religious cause at a drive is not allowed. We may ask anyone to leave a drive or stop volunteering.

Food we distribute comes from vendors, kitchens and donors. We take reasonable care in arranging, handling and handing it out, but we do not prepare it ourselves and cannot guarantee it is free from allergens or suitable for every diet.
Information on this website is shared in good faith and may change without notice. Impact numbers and the donation calculator are estimates.

Photos, text and the Hunger Warriors name and logo belong to Hunger Warriors. You may share them for non-commercial purposes with credit. Do not use our name or logo to raise money, or for any other purpose, without our written permission.
Beware of anyone collecting money in our name. If someone asks you to pay elsewhere on our behalf, check with us first and report it to us.
Do not misuse this website, try to disrupt it, or use it for anything unlawful.
Links to other websites and apps (WhatsApp, PhonePe, maps and others) are provided for convenience. Their own terms and privacy policies apply, and we are not responsible for them.
This website is provided "as is". To the fullest extent the law allows, Hunger Warriors is not liable for any indirect or consequential loss arising from using this website, donating or volunteering.
You agree to indemnify Hunger Warriors and its volunteers against claims arising from your misuse of this website or breach of these policies.
These policies are governed by the laws of India, and the courts in Kolkata, West Bengal have exclusive jurisdiction.

sections.title: Cookies & Third-Party Services
blocks: We don't use advertising or analytics cookies, and we don't track you across the web.
This site remembers small things in your own browser (for example, that you closed a drive reminder). That information never leaves your device.
Pages load a few things from trusted outside services, which may see your IP address under their own privacy policies:

list: Google Fonts, for the lettering.
OpenStreetMap and cdnjs (Cloudflare), for the map.
WhatsApp, only when you tap a WhatsApp button.
Your UPI app, PhonePe or bank, only when you choose to donate.

sections.title: Changes to these policies
blocks: We may update these policies from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when they last changed. Continuing to use this website, donate or volunteer after a change means you accept the updated policies.
